predictions.quote: I'll make a prediction, I'll bet that in the next five years we will see a major household name OEM fail or need a bailout due to lack of access to a material.
predictions.prediction: Within the next five years (by approximately 2027), a major well-known automotive OEM will fail or require a bailout because of an inability to access a critical material (such as rare earths) needed for production, rather than because of price increases alone.
